zkverifyAggregationProxy.notes: Mainnet address is deterministic — same on Base (8453), Arbitrum One (42161), OP Mainnet (10), and Horizen (26514). Testnet address differs per chain. Domain ID 3 targets Horizen mainnet; domain ID 175 targets Horizen testnet. Primary function: verifyProofAggregation(domainId, aggregationId, leaf, merklePath, leafCount, index). Storage mapping: proofsAggregations(domainId, aggregationId) → bytes32 merkleRoot. Do NOT infer deployment on chains not explicitly listed in this entry.

zenToken.notes: ZEN is the governance and value-routing token of the Horizen ecosystem. On Horizen the ERC-20 and OFT contract share the same address. Origin chain is Base — mainnet Base ERC-20: 0xf43eB8De897Fbc7F2502483B2Bef7Bb9EA179229; Base OFT Adapter: 0x57da2D504bf8b83Ef304759d9f2648522D7a9280. ZEN is NOT the gas token — gas is paid in ETH. Testnet token is tZEN on Base Sepolia: 0x107fdE93838e3404934877935993782F977324BB.

cbtcToken.notes: Coinbase-custodied Bitcoin bridged via LayerZero OFT. Decimals: 8 (NOT 18 — using 18-decimal assumptions breaks integrations). On Horizen the ERC-20 and OFT contract share the same address. Base cbBTC ERC-20: 0xcbB7C0000aB88B473b1f5aFd9ef808440eed33Bf; Base OFT Adapter: 0x68fb5BB8330C0b9d907F50f278143873276ee056. 1:1 backed by BTC held by Coinbase.

usdceToken.notes: Bridged USDC via Stargate Hydra — the .e suffix denotes bridged (not native Circle-issued) USDC. Decimals: 6 (NOT 18). Base USDC (Circle): 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. No testnet deployment. Contract address unchanged if upgraded to native USDC.

purefi.notes: Mainnet only — no testnet deployment exists. Contracts must be registered in the PureFi Dashboard before use. validatePayload is a synchronous blocking call; revert propagates to the caller. referencePath is the integration overview; tutorialPath is the compliance-gating implementation guide.

den.notes: Browser-based interface only — no CLI or terminal tooling. referencePath is the conceptual overview of what Den is; tutorialPath is the step-by-step implementation guide. Agents should read both: understand the concept first, then follow the tutorial. Scripted/programmatic access goes through the Safe Protocol Kit directly against Safe contracts, not through Den.

zkverify.notes: Verifier contract is deployed on both Horizen mainnet and testnet (different addresses — see zkverifyAggregationProxy contract entry). No Horizen docs page exists yet — referencePath and tutorialPath are null because documentation lags the deployment. Proof verification happens on zkVerify (a separate L1); Horizen contracts verify aggregation receipts via Merkle proof. Horizen mainnet domain ID: 3. Horizen testnet domain ID: 175. verifyProofAggregation takes 6 params: domainId, aggregationId, leaf, merklePath, leafCount, index. Storage mapping proofsAggregations(domainId, aggregationId) → bytes32 merkleRoot for existence checks. Terminology: zkVerify moved from 'attestation' to 'aggregation' — use current terms.
